name: Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia
short_description: A half-marathon event in BSD City, Indonesia, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances on September 20, 2026.
ai_summary: Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia is a half-marathon event scheduled for September 20, 2026, held at the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) in BSD City, Indonesia. Runners can choose from three distances: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration has not yet been announced, so prospective participants should check back for updates on how to sign up.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit different fitness levels
Held at a well-known venue, the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) in BSD City
Part of the established Garmin Run Asia Series
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable

excerpt_quotes.quote: Garmin Run Indonesia membuat kami merasa diterima sepenuhnya. Sejak pertama kali ikut dua tahun lalu, saya merasa event ini tidak hanya tentang lari, tetapi juga tentang kebersamaan.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Ricendy, #PelariIsyarat and Garmin Run Club member, quoted in Garmin Indonesia press release

research_highlights: Course starts and finishes at the Hall 10 parking area of ICE BSD (Indonesia Convention Exhibition), Tangerang, with categories of 5K, 10K, Half Marathon (21K) and a Kids Dash.
The course is described by local tech media as relatively flat in the BSD area, which is why runners often use it to chase a personal best time.
The event has grown year over year: the 2025 edition drew over 7,000 participants, and the 2026 edition is targeting 8,000 runners.

The race has strong inclusivity features reported by participants and organizers, including sign-language interpreters, large visual countdown screens, and wheelchair-accessible routes for disabled runners.

For 2026 the event has been rebranded from 'Garmin Run Asia Series' to 'Garmin Run Marathon Series', adding AI-based health screening and wearable tech integration alongside the same 5K/10K/21K/Kids Dash format.
research_watchouts: Race-day crowds are large — one report described the start area as turning into a 'sea of people' ('lautan manusia') with thousands massing before dawn, so expect crowded starting corrals.

Most available English/Indonesian coverage found is organizer press material or sponsored event recaps rather than independent runner reviews, so course-condition details (heat, water stations, crowding on route) are not well documented by third parties.

faqs.question: When is the Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia taking place?
faqs.answer: The Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia is scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026. This date has been confirmed for the event, which will be held at the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) in BSD City, Indonesia, according to the available information.

faqs.question: What distances can I run in this event?
faqs.answer: Participants in the Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia can choose from three distance options: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range allows runners of varying experience and fitness levels to select an appropriate challenge for the event.

faqs.question: Can I register for the race now?
faqs.answer: As of the latest available information, the registration status for the Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia has not yet been announced. Prospective participants should monitor official channels for updates on when and how registration will open ahead of the September 20, 2026 event date.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE), located in BSD City, Indonesia. This venue serves as the host site for the Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia, which includes 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance categories for runners.
